### Making the Words Our Own
Author: Nik Ripkin
Site: Bible Gateway Blog
URL: https://www.biblegateway.com/blog/2020/05/making-the-words-our-own/
Passage: Deuteronomy 17:19
Points:
- God commanded Israel's kings to write out their own scroll of the law and read it every day.
- Hand-copying the text forced leaders to slow down and let divine instruction shape their hearts.
- An imprisoned pastor demonstrated the power of Scripture by recording remembered verses on paper scraps.
- Daily busyness often keeps believers from allowing God's Word to take deep root within them.

### God’s Word… Written on Your Heart
Author: David Jeremiah
Site: DavidJeremiah.org
URL: https://www.davidjeremiah.org/magazine/article/gods-word-written-on-your-heart-265
Passage: Deuteronomy 17:18-20
Points:
- God required Israel's kings to personally transcribe His law before taking the throne.
- Hand-copying Scripture slows the mind down and helps counter the frenetic distractions of modern life.
- Keeping the Word close at all times provides ongoing guidance, wisdom, and moral strength.
- Daily immersion in God's statutes guards leaders against arrogance and turns their hearts toward reverence.
